title: Euclidean Extension of Hierarchical Susceptibility Asymptotics
exact_target: Prove the Euclidean periodic-model analogue of the hierarchical model's universal finite-size susceptibility asymptotics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005178 (OWR-11101914-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Renormalization Group (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2022/33, pp. 1865--1925. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The scaling window, normalization and asymptotic function are those of the hierarchical result in the cited report; changing those quantities would give a different comparison.
